title: Orchard and Bakery
author: Ansel Ashgrove
blurb: Beatrix Pemberton, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
